sections.name: Laws & Regulations
sections.description: Primary legal texts on privacy, cybersecurity and AI, with current status and key dates.

sections.name: Regulators & Official Guidance
sections.description: Authorities that enforce these laws and the guidance they publish.

sections.name: Frameworks & Standards
sections.description: Standards, control sets and principles used to build, assess and audit programs.

sections.name: Certifications
sections.description: Professional credentials in privacy, security, AI governance and e-discovery, beginner to expert.

sections.name: Learning Center
sections.description: Courses, labs and training programs. Courses teach a subject; they are not certifications.

sections.name: Events
sections.description: Conferences, summits and training events from November 2026 onward.

sections.name: Research & Trackers
sections.description: Law trackers, enforcement databases, annual reports and research libraries.

sections.name: Newsletters & News
sections.description: News sites, newsletters and law-firm blogs that track developments.

sections.name: Podcasts
sections.description: Shows on privacy, security, AI policy and tech law.

sections.name: Books & Literature
sections.description: Foundational and current books and articles, checked against real publications.

sections.name: Tools & Templates
sections.description: Free or low-cost tools, templates and assessment kits practitioners use.

sections.name: Communities & Associations
sections.description: Professional bodies, advocacy groups and communities to join.

sections.name: Job Boards & Careers
sections.description: Where to find roles, plus salary and workforce data.

resources.name: General Data Protection Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2016/679)
resources.description: EU regulation setting rules for processing personal data, data subject rights, controller and processor duties, transfers and fines.
resources.publisher: European Parliament and Council of the EU

resources.name: EU Artificial Intelligence Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689)
resources.description: Risk-based EU rules for AI systems and general-purpose AI models: prohibited practices, high-risk requirements, transparency and governance.
resources.publisher: European Parliament and Council of the EU

resources.name: NIS2 Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
resources.description: EU directive requiring essential and important entities in critical sectors to manage cybersecurity risk and report significant incidents.
resources.publisher: European Parliament and Council of the EU

resources.name: Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) (Regulation (EU) 2022/2554)
resources.description: EU regulation on ICT risk management, incident reporting, resilience testing and third-party ICT risk for financial entities.
resources.publisher: European Parliament and Council of the EU

resources.name: Cyber Resilience Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/2847)
resources.description: EU regulation setting cybersecurity requirements for hardware and software products with digital elements across their lifecycle.
resources.publisher: European Parliament and Council of the EU

resources.name: EU Data Act (Regulation (EU) 2023/2854)
resources.description: EU regulation on access to and use of data from connected products and related services, B2B data sharing terms and cloud switching.
resources.publisher: European Parliament and Council of the EU

resources.name: ePrivacy Directive (Directive 2002/58/EC)
resources.description: EU directive on privacy in electronic communications, covering confidentiality, cookies and similar tracking, traffic data and direct marketing.
resources.publisher: European Parliament and Council of the EU

resources.name: UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018
resources.description: UK framework for personal data processing: the Act supplements the retained UK GDPR and covers law enforcement and intelligence processing.

resources.name: Data (Use and Access) Act 2025
resources.description: UK Act amending UK GDPR, DPA 2018 and PECR, creating smart data and digital verification regimes, and restructuring the ICO.

resources.name: HIPAA Privacy, Security and Breach Notification Rules (45 CFR Parts 160 and 164)
resources.description: US federal rules governing use, disclosure and security of protected health information by covered entities and business associates.
resources.publisher: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services

resources.name: GLBA Safeguards Rule (16 CFR Part 314)
resources.description: FTC rule under the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act requiring non-bank financial institutions to run an information security program.

resources.name: Children's Online Privacy Protection Rule (COPPA Rule) (16 CFR Part 312)
resources.description: FTC rule requiring verifiable parental consent and data limits for online services directed to, or knowingly collecting data from, children under 13.

resources.name: FERPA Regulations (34 CFR Part 99)
resources.description: US Department of Education rules on the privacy of student education records, parental and student access rights, and disclosure limits.

resources.name: SEC Cybersecurity Risk Management, Strategy, Governance, and Incident Disclosure Rules (Release 33-11216)
resources.description: SEC rules requiring public companies to disclose material cybersecurity incidents on Form 8-K and describe cyber risk governance annually.

resources.name: Cyber Incident Reporting for Critical Infrastructure Act of 2022 (CIRCIA)
resources.description: US law directing CISA to require critical infrastructure entities to report covered cyber incidents and ransom payments.

resources.name: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. 45)
resources.description: US statute prohibiting unfair or deceptive acts or practices; the FTC's main legal basis for privacy, data security and AI enforcement.

resources.name: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), as amended by the CPRA (Cal. Civ. Code 1798.100 et seq.)
resources.description: California statute giving consumers rights to know, delete, correct and opt out of sale or sharing of personal information.

resources.name: CCPA Regulations on ADMT, Risk Assessments and Cybersecurity Audits (Cal. Code Regs. tit. 11, § 7000 et seq.)
resources.description: CalPrivacy regulations adding automated decisionmaking technology rights, privacy risk assessments and annual cybersecurity audits to the CCPA rules.

resources.name: Colorado AI Act (SB 24-205), repealed and reenacted by SB 26-189 (Automated Decision-Making Technology)
resources.description: Colorado law regulating automated decision-making technology used in consequential decisions such as employment, housing, lending and insurance.

resources.name: Texas Responsible Artificial Intelligence Governance Act (TRAIGA) (HB 149)
resources.description: Texas law banning certain intentional harmful AI uses, setting disclosure duties for government and health AI uses, and creating an AI sandbox.

resources.name: Texas Data Privacy and Security Act (TDPSA) (HB 4)
resources.description: Texas consumer privacy law granting access, deletion, correction and opt-out rights and requiring data protection assessments.

resources.name: Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act (VCDPA) (Va. Code 59.1-575 et seq.)
resources.description: Virginia consumer privacy law with access, deletion, correction and opt-out rights, sensitive-data consent and data protection assessments.

resources.name: Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act (BIPA) (740 ILCS 14)
resources.description: Illinois law requiring notice, written consent and retention policies for biometric identifiers, with a private right of action.

resources.name: NYC Local Law 144 of 2021 (Automated Employment Decision Tools)
resources.description: New York City law requiring annual bias audits, public audit summaries and candidate notices before employers use automated employment decision tools.
resources.publisher: New York City Council; Department of Consumer and Worker Protection

resources.name: NYDFS Cybersecurity Regulation (23 NYCRR Part 500)
resources.description: New York DFS rule requiring regulated financial entities to maintain cybersecurity programs, CISO oversight, MFA and 72-hour incident notice.
resources.publisher: New York State Department of Financial Services

resources.name: Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023
resources.description: Nigerian statute governing personal data processing, data subject rights, cross-border transfers, and establishing the Nigeria Data Protection Commission.

resources.name: NDPC General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2025
resources.description: NDPC directive implementing the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023, covering compliance audits, DPOs, DPIAs, legitimate interest and emerging tech.

resources.name: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA)
resources.description: South African law setting conditions for lawful processing of personal information, data subject rights, breach notification and direct marketing limits.

resources.name: Kenya Data Protection Act, 2019 (No. 24 of 2019)
resources.description: Kenyan statute regulating personal data processing, data subject rights, controller and processor registration, and the Data Commissioner's powers.

resources.name: Brazil General Data Protection Law (LGPD) (Law No. 13,709/2018)
resources.description: Brazilian law governing personal data processing, legal bases, data subject rights and international transfers, enforced by the ANPD.

resources.name: India Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and DPDP Rules, 2025
resources.description: Indian law and implementing rules governing digital personal data processing, consent, data principal rights and the Data Protection Board.
resources.publisher: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)

resources.name: Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) (S.C. 2000, c. 5)
resources.description: Canadian federal law governing how private-sector organizations collect, use and disclose personal information in commercial activity.

resources.name: Singapore Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (PDPA)
resources.description: Singapore law governing private-sector collection, use and disclosure of personal data, including consent, breach notification and Do Not Call rules.

resources.name: Japan Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI)
resources.description: Japanese law on business handling of personal information, including purpose limits, third-party provision, cross-border transfers and breach reports.
resources.publisher: National Diet of Japan; Personal Information Protection Commission

resources.name: Council of Europe Framework Convention on Artificial Intelligence and Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law (CETS No. 225)
resources.description: First binding international treaty on AI, requiring parties to ensure AI lifecycle activities respect human rights, democracy and the rule of law.

resources.name: Federal Trade Commission (FTC)
resources.description: US federal agency enforcing consumer protection law on privacy, data security and AI claims, plus COPPA, the GLBA Safeguards Rule and related rules.

resources.name: California Privacy Protection Agency (CalPrivacy)
resources.description: California agency that issues CCPA regulations, enforces the CCPA and runs the data broker registry and Delete Request and Opt-out Platform (DROP).

resources.name: HHS Office for Civil Rights (OCR) - HIPAA
resources.description: US HHS office that enforces the HIPAA Privacy, Security and Breach Notification Rules and publishes guidance and enforcement actions.
resources.publisher: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services

resources.name: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)
resources.description: US securities regulator overseeing public company cybersecurity disclosure, Regulation S-P customer data safeguards and cyber-related enforcement.

resources.name: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) - Resources for Lawyers
resources.description: US federal cyber defense agency; this CISA page gathers resources for lawyers on incident reporting, information sharing and legal frameworks.

resources.name: NIST Center for Advancing Innovation and Standards for Super Intelligence (CAISSI)
resources.description: NIST center that works with industry on AI model testing, evaluations and voluntary standards; successor to the US AI Safety Institute.
resources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology

resources.name: European Data Protection Board (EDPB)
resources.description: EU body of national data protection authorities that issues GDPR guidelines and opinions and adopts binding decisions in cross-border cases.

resources.name: European AI Office
resources.description: European Commission office implementing the AI Act, supervising general-purpose AI models and coordinating AI Act guidance and codes of practice.

resources.name: European Union Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA)
resources.description: EU cybersecurity agency supporting NIS2 implementation, certification schemes, threat reporting and the Cyber Resilience Act reporting platform.

resources.name: UK Information Commission (formerly Information Commissioner's Office, ICO)
resources.description: UK regulator for data protection, PECR and freedom of information, publishing guidance, codes of practice and enforcement actions.

resources.name: CNIL (Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertes)
resources.description: French data protection authority known for GDPR and cookie enforcement and practical guidance on AI system development.

resources.name: Data Protection Commission (Ireland)
resources.description: Irish data protection authority and GDPR lead supervisory authority for many large technology companies with EU headquarters in Ireland.

resources.name: Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC)
resources.description: Nigerian regulator established by the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 to enforce data protection, register controllers and issue directives.

resources.name: Information Regulator (South Africa)
resources.description: South African regulator enforcing POPIA and the Promotion of Access to Information Act, issuing guidance notes and enforcement notices.

resources.name: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC) Kenya
resources.description: Kenyan regulator under the Data Protection Act 2019 handling registration of controllers and processors, complaints, guidance and penalties.
resources.publisher: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner

resources.name: Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada (OPC)
resources.description: Canadian federal privacy oversight body for PIPEDA and the Privacy Act, publishing investigations, findings and guidance.
resources.publisher: Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada

resources.name: Personal Data Protection Commission (PDPC) Singapore
resources.description: Singapore regulator administering the PDPA, issuing advisory guidelines, enforcement decisions and AI and data governance guidance.

resources.name: Global Privacy Assembly (GPA)
resources.description: Global forum of data protection and privacy authorities that adopts resolutions and runs working groups on enforcement, AI and data sharing.

resources.name: Texas Attorney General - Consumer Privacy Enforcement
resources.description: Texas AG office enforcing TDPSA, TRAIGA, biometric (CUBI) and children's online privacy laws through investigations and lawsuits.
resources.publisher: Office of the Texas Attorney General

resources.name: New York State Department of Financial Services (NYDFS)
resources.description: New York financial regulator enforcing the Part 500 cybersecurity regulation and issuing cyber and AI risk guidance to regulated entities.
resources.publisher: New York State Department of Financial Services

resources.name: Brazil National Data Protection Agency (ANPD)
resources.description: Brazilian authority that regulates and enforces the LGPD, issuing regulations on sanctions, international transfers and data protection officers.
resources.publisher: Autoridade Nacional de Protecao de Dados

resources.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
resources.description: Voluntary framework of cybersecurity outcomes under six functions (Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, Recover) for managing cyber risk.

resources.name: NIST Privacy Framework 1.0
resources.description: Voluntary tool for identifying and managing privacy risk, organized into a Core, Profiles and Implementation Tiers, designed to work with the NIST CSF.

resources.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
resources.description: Voluntary framework for managing risks of AI systems through four functions (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage) and defined characteristics of trustworthy AI.

resources.name: NIST AI 600-1: Generative AI Profile
resources.description: Cross-sector AI RMF profile identifying 12 risks unique to or worsened by generative AI, with suggested actions for managing each one.

resources.name: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: Security and Privacy Controls
resources.description: Catalog of security and privacy controls for information systems and organizations; baseline for US federal systems and FedRAMP, widely used elsewhere.

resources.name: NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3: Incident Response Recommendations
resources.description: NIST guidance for building incident response into cybersecurity risk management, structured as a CSF 2.0 Community Profile.

resources.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
resources.description: Requirements for establishing, maintaining and improving an information security management system (ISMS); the basis for ISO 27001 certification.

resources.name: ISO/IEC 27002:2022
resources.description: Reference set of 93 information security controls with implementation guidance, grouped into organizational, people, physical and technological themes.

resources.name: ISO/IEC 27701:2025
resources.description: Requirements and guidance for a privacy information management system (PIMS) for PII controllers and processors; certifiable on its own.

resources.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023
resources.description: Requirements for an AI management system (AIMS) covering responsible development, provision and use of AI systems; certifiable.

resources.name: ISO/IEC 23894:2023
resources.description: Guidance on managing risks specific to AI systems, adapting ISO 31000 risk management principles and processes to AI.

resources.name: ISO/IEC 29100:2024
resources.description: Privacy framework defining common terminology, actors and roles, and 11 privacy principles for protecting PII in ICT systems.

resources.name: ISO 31700-1:2023: Privacy by Design for Consumer Goods and Services
resources.description: High-level requirements for applying privacy by design to consumer goods and services across their lifecycle, with the consumer at the center.

resources.name: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (SOC 2)
resources.description: AICPA criteria for security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality and privacy, used to evaluate controls in SOC 2 attestation reports.

resources.name: PCI DSS v4.0.1
resources.description: Security requirements for organizations that store, process or transmit payment card data, enforced through card brand compliance programs.

resources.name: CIS Critical Security Controls v8.1
resources.description: Prioritized set of 18 controls and their safeguards, tiered into three Implementation Groups, for defending against common cyberattacks.

resources.name: MITRE ATT&CK
resources.description: Curated knowledge base of adversary tactics and techniques observed in real-world attacks, used for threat modeling, detection engineering and red teaming.

resources.name: MITRE ATLAS
resources.description: Knowledge base of adversary tactics, techniques and case studies targeting AI and machine learning systems, modeled on MITRE ATT&CK.

resources.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2026
resources.description: Ranked list of the ten most critical security risks in large language model applications, with mitigations, from the OWASP GenAI Security Project.

resources.name: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026
resources.description: Peer-reviewed list of the ten most critical security risks for autonomous AI agents that plan and act across tools and workflows, with mitigations.

resources.name: OWASP Top 10:2025 (Web Application Security Risks)
resources.description: Awareness document listing the ten most critical web application security risks, used as a baseline for secure development and testing.

resources.name: OECD AI Principles
resources.description: Intergovernmental principles for trustworthy, human-centric AI: five values-based principles and five recommendations for policymakers.

resources.name: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence
resources.description: Global standard-setting instrument on AI ethics adopted by UNESCO member states, setting out values, principles and policy action areas.

resources.name: Fair Information Practice Principles (FIPPs)
resources.description: Nine widely accepted principles US federal agencies use to evaluate systems, programs and activities that affect individual privacy.

resources.name: HITRUST CSF
resources.description: Certifiable control framework that harmonizes 60+ authoritative sources such as HIPAA, ISO 27001, NIST and PCI DSS; widely used in US healthcare.

resources.name: CSA Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM) v4.1
resources.description: Cloud security control framework of 207 controls in 17 domains, mapped to major standards and used for CSA STAR assurance.

resources.name: CSA AI Controls Matrix (AICM) v1.1
resources.description: Control framework for trustworthy AI and cloud: 247 control objectives in 18 domains, mapped to ISO 42001, the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF.

resources.name: COBIT 2019
resources.description: ISACA framework for governance and management of enterprise information and technology, built on 40 governance and management objectives.

resources.name: IEEE 7000-2021: Addressing Ethical Concerns During System Design
resources.description: IEEE model process for identifying and addressing ethical values and concerns during system design, known as value-based engineering.

resources.name: IOPD Design Process Standard v1.0
resources.description: Process standard from the Institute of Operational Privacy Design for building privacy risk management into product and service design.

resources.name: CIPP/US – Certified Information Privacy Professional/United States
resources.description: Covers US federal and state privacy laws, regulators and data-handling rules; suits lawyers, compliance and privacy staff working with US data.

resources.name: CIPP/E – Certified Information Privacy Professional/Europe
resources.description: Covers GDPR and wider European data protection law, cross-border transfers and enforcement; suits privacy lawyers and DPO-track professionals.

resources.name: CIPP/C – Certified Information Privacy Professional/Canada
resources.description: Covers Canadian federal, provincial and territorial privacy law and practice; suits privacy and compliance staff handling Canadian personal data.

resources.name: CIPP/A – Certified Information Privacy Professional/Asia
resources.description: Covers privacy laws and practices across major Asian economies; suits privacy and compliance professionals with operations in Asia.

resources.name: CIPM – Certified Information Privacy Manager
resources.description: Covers building and running a privacy program: governance, policies, assessments, metrics and incident response; suits privacy program managers.

resources.name: CIPT – Certified Information Privacy Technologist
resources.description: Covers privacy by design and technical privacy controls in products and systems; suits engineers, architects and IT staff working on privacy.

resources.name: AIGP – Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional
resources.description: Covers AI governance: AI lifecycle risks, responsible AI principles, and how laws and frameworks apply to AI; suits privacy, legal and risk staff.

resources.name: FIP – Fellow of Information Privacy
resources.description: IAPP's senior designation for privacy professionals who hold a CIPP plus a CIPM, CIPT or AIGP and have three years of substantial privacy work.
resources.cost: No added fee once the two required IAPP credentials are held

resources.name: PLS – Privacy Law Specialist
resources.description: ABA-accredited specialty designation from IAPP for US-licensed attorneys who practice privacy law; builds on CIPP/US plus CIPM or CIPT.

resources.name: CDPSE – Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer
resources.description: Covers privacy governance, privacy risk and compliance, data lifecycle management and privacy engineering; suits technical staff building privacy into systems.

resources.name: CISA – Certified Information Systems Auditor
resources.description: Covers IT audit, control assessment and assurance of information systems; suits IT auditors and compliance professionals.

resources.name: CISM – Certified Information Security Manager
resources.description: Covers information security governance, risk management, security program development and incident management; suits security managers.

resources.name: CRISC – Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control
resources.description: Covers IT risk identification, assessment, response and control monitoring; suits risk, compliance and control professionals.

resources.name: AAIA – ISACA Advanced in AI Audit
resources.description: Covers auditing AI systems, AI governance and AI-related risks and controls; for experienced auditors who already hold CISA or a qualifying credential.

resources.name: AAISM – ISACA Advanced in AI Security Management
resources.description: Covers AI security governance, AI risk management and AI security controls; for security managers who already hold CISM or CISSP.

resources.name: AAIR – ISACA Advanced in AI Risk
resources.description: Covers identifying, assessing and managing AI risk across the risk lifecycle; for IT risk professionals who hold CRISC or another qualifying credential.

resources.name: CC – ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity
resources.description: Entry-level credential covering security principles, access control, network security and security operations; no work experience required.

resources.name: CISSP – Certified Information Systems Security Professional
resources.description: Covers eight security domains from risk management to software security; suits experienced security practitioners, managers and architects.

resources.name: CCSP – Certified Cloud Security Professional
resources.description: Covers cloud architecture, cloud data security, platform and application security, operations, and cloud legal, risk and compliance.

resources.name: CGRC – ISC2 Governance, Risk and Compliance Certification
resources.description: Covers authorizing and maintaining information systems under risk frameworks such as NIST RMF; suits GRC and compliance professionals.

resources.name: CompTIA Security+
resources.description: Entry-level, vendor-neutral exam covering threats, security architecture, operations and governance basics; a common first security credential.

resources.name: CompTIA CySA+ – Cybersecurity Analyst
resources.description: Intermediate exam on security operations, threat detection, vulnerability management and incident response; suits SOC and security analyst roles.

resources.name: CompTIA SecurityX (formerly CASP+)
resources.description: Advanced exam on security architecture, engineering, operations and GRC for senior practitioners; CompTIA's renamed successor to CASP+.

resources.name: GSEC – GIAC Security Essentials
resources.description: Covers core security skills across networks, endpoints and cloud; suits practitioners moving beyond entry level. Aligned with SANS SEC401.

resources.name: CEH – Certified Ethical Hacker
resources.description: Covers ethical hacking tools and techniques across reconnaissance, system, web and cloud attacks; suits early-career penetration testers and analysts.

resources.name: OSCP+ – OffSec Certified Professional
resources.description: Hands-on penetration testing credential earned through a proctored practical exam after OffSec's PEN-200 course; suits aspiring pentesters.

resources.name: PECB ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor
resources.description: Covers implementing (LI) or auditing (LA) an ISO/IEC 27001 information security management system; suits ISMS leads, consultants and auditors.

resources.name: PECB ISO/IEC 27701 Lead Implementer
resources.description: Covers implementing a privacy information management system (PIMS) under ISO/IEC 27701; suits privacy and security program leads.

resources.name: PECB ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor
resources.description: Covers implementing or auditing an AI management system under ISO/IEC 42001; suits AI governance, risk and audit professionals.

resources.name: CEDS – Certified E-Discovery Specialist
resources.description: Covers the e-discovery process, including EDRM, preservation, collection, review and production; suits litigation support staff, paralegals and lawyers.

resources.name: ACI Learning
resources.description: IT, cybersecurity and audit video training, including the former ITProTV catalog, with prep for CompTIA, ISC2, ISACA and similar exams.

resources.name: Cybrary
resources.description: Online cybersecurity courses, career paths and practice labs with a free tier and paid plans; suits beginners through working practitioners.

resources.name: CISA Cybersecurity Training & Exercises
resources.description: Free cybersecurity training and exercises from the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency for public and private sector staff.

resources.name: SANS Institute
resources.description: Intensive cybersecurity training across defense, offense, forensics, cloud, AI security and leadership, aligned with GIAC certifications.

resources.name: edX
resources.description: University and industry courses, including cybersecurity, AI and law topics, with free audit on many courses and paid certificates.

resources.name: Pluralsight
resources.description: Subscription video courses, skill assessments and labs for IT, cloud, security and AI; suits technical staff building job skills.

resources.name: Udacity
resources.description: Project-based online programs (Nanodegrees) in AI, data and cybersecurity with mentor feedback; suits learners wanting structured technical study.

resources.name: McAfee Institute
resources.description: Online training and certifications in investigations, cyber intelligence and fraud; suits investigators and intelligence analysts.

resources.name: CodePath
resources.description: Nonprofit offering free technical courses, including cybersecurity, mainly to US college students from underrepresented backgrounds.

resources.name: StationX
resources.description: UK-based cybersecurity training platform with course bundles, official CompTIA training, discounted exam vouchers and career coaching.

resources.name: TryHackMe
resources.description: Browser-based guided cybersecurity labs and learning paths from beginner to advanced, with a free tier and a paid subscription.

resources.name: Hack The Box
resources.description: Hands-on penetration testing labs, Academy courses and CTF challenges, plus its own job-role certifications; suits intermediate to advanced learners.

resources.name: Stanford Online
resources.description: Stanford's online courses and professional certificates, including AI and computer security programs; mostly paid, with some free courses.

resources.name: Harvard Online
resources.description: Harvard's online courses for professionals, including cybersecurity and AI topics; paid, often in cohort-based formats.

resources.name: IAPP Training (CIPP, CIPM, CIPT, AIGP)
resources.description: Official IAPP training for the CIPP, CIPM, CIPT and AIGP exams, offered self-paced online, live online, in person or for groups.

resources.name: IAPP AIGP Training
resources.description: Official AIGP prep covering AI foundations, AI risk and governance, AI laws and standards, and governing AI development and deployment.

resources.name: IAPP Foundations of Privacy and Data Protection
resources.description: Introductory course on privacy concepts, Fair Information Practices, the data life cycle and major privacy laws; suits newcomers and non-privacy staff.

resources.name: Privacy Bootcamp
resources.description: Self-paced online exam prep for IAPP CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPP/C, CIPM, CIPT and AIGP, with practice exams and lifetime access.

resources.name: Infosec Institute IAPP Training
resources.description: Live online boot camps and on-demand courses for CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM and CIPT with practice exams; Infosec also covers security certifications.

resources.name: SANS SEC401: Security Essentials – Network, Endpoint, and Cloud
resources.description: Six-day security essentials course covering network, endpoint and cloud defense with 20 hands-on labs; prepares for the GIAC GSEC exam.

resources.name: SANS LDR519: Cybersecurity Governance, Risk, and Compliance
resources.description: GRC course covering governance, safeguard selection, program management, validation and risk reporting, with simulation-based labs.

resources.name: SANS SEC545: GenAI and LLM Application Security
resources.description: Advanced course on securing GenAI and LLM apps: threat modeling, RAG and vector database defense, prompt injection and MLOps hardening.

resources.name: SANS Free Webcasts, Summits and Community Nights
resources.description: Free SANS webcasts, virtual summits and local community nights on current security topics; many webcasts earn CPE credits.

resources.name: Elements of AI
resources.description: Free introductory online course on what AI is, what it can and cannot do, and its effects on society; no math or coding needed.

resources.name: Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate
resources.description: Beginner program covering security basics, networks, Linux, SQL, Python, SIEM tools and incident response; suits career changers.

resources.name: Cisco Networking Academy
resources.description: Cisco's learning platform with free self-paced courses such as Introduction to Cybersecurity and Ethical Hacker, plus instructor-led paths.

resources.name: PortSwigger Web Security Academy
resources.description: Free web application security training with interactive labs on SQL injection, XSS, access control and LLM attacks, from the makers of Burp Suite.

resources.name: CS50's Introduction to Cybersecurity
resources.description: Free Harvard course on securing accounts, data, systems and software, written for technical and non-technical learners alike.

resources.name: AI For Everyone
resources.description: Non-technical course by Andrew Ng on AI terms, what AI can do, running AI projects and AI's effects on society; suits managers and lawyers.

resources.name: OWASP Juice Shop
resources.description: Free, intentionally insecure web app for practicing attacks across the OWASP Top 10; runs locally or in containers for self-study and training.

resources.name: Santa Clara Law Certificate Programs (Privacy, High Tech Law)
resources.description: JD certificate programs in privacy law and high tech law at a Silicon Valley law school; suits law students focusing on tech law.
resources.publisher: Santa Clara University School of Law

resources.name: SANS AI Cybersecurity Summit Fall 2026
resources.description: SANS summit on securing AI systems and agents and applying AI in security operations, with talks and workshops in person or online.
resources.cost: US$525 in person; US$100 live online

resources.name: Privacy + Security Forum Fall Academy 2026
resources.description: Washington, DC conference on privacy and data security law and practice, organised by Privacy + Security Academy, with CLE/CPE credit.

resources.name: Global Privacy Assembly 2026 (48th Annual Meeting)
resources.description: Annual meeting of the world's data protection and privacy authorities; closed session for members and observers, open programme held within IAPP Congress.

resources.name: IAPP Europe Congress 2026
resources.description: IAPP's main European conference on GDPR, EU data protection, AI governance and enforcement, with training and workshops before the main programme.
resources.cost: Main conference €1,745 (IAPP members) / €1,945 (non-members); public sector €790, academic €550

resources.name: Black Hat Middle East & Africa 2026
resources.description: Regional Black Hat edition for the Middle East and Africa with security briefings, trainings and a large exhibition.
